status_note: LD-medusa-ue (2026-09-29): UE import of the Medusa look-dev run 20260929-h2-lookdev (profile medusa-h2-lookdev/1: H2.1 figure + UV1 in metres, MatID, EdgeMask, graded BC/ORM, TeamMask only on cloth) through the CLI profile skeletal-adopt: adopt pins the look-dev FBX pair, the 2K maps and the hero MatLUT against the look-dev reports (normaliser h2-lookdev/1), ue-import creates MI of /Game/UM/Materials/v2/M_UM_Figure_v2 (MatIDTexture, MatLUT, EdgeMaskTexture, UseUV1Metres) and of M_UM_BaseMarker for the base. At most «технически импортировано»/«измерено»; no art acceptance, no budget (GD-058 open); team colours Blue/Red are a diagnostic pair (Q-304 open). Rev 2 (look-dev C, group A, 2026-09-30): the mesh goes onto the canonical skeleton /Game/PipelineCandidates/Medusa/Rig/SK_Medusa_Skeleton (ue.target_skeleton, CLI 0.8.0; the former own SK_Medusa_H2LD_Skeleton is deleted by the run), master v2.1 UseTeamAccent with the TeamAccent mask of the look-dev run (library_inputs.TeamAccent), one gain rule for both teams (TeamDyeGain 0.8 / Y_p50 + TeamDyeCeiling 0.9 / Y_p95), teams = the active C-11 palette P1 #E8C06A / P2 #5A7F9F (user decision «Акценты + кольцо»); the deprecated W4-B TeamMask is no longer imported (TeamMaskTexture = T_UM_Mask_Black, team_color_mode none).
